item.title: commandline: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is now generally available for fast, low-cost decision making
item.description:
Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is now generally available in Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter, and Vercel. Microsoft says it has been used by more than 4,000 customers since its public preview launch last month.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
